message:
Goose: batched list reads and cheaper list SQL

List reads of one kind that queue while a batch is in flight go to Postgres as
one statement (unnest WITH ORDINALITY + LATERAL), routed back by member number.
When most members ask for the same page, each article's details are read once.
GET /api/tags reads waiting together share one execution. Global and tag lists
read favorite count and favorited in one scan; the favorited list and comments
read the viewer's sets once; create inserts only missing tags.

On c4-highcpu-8 the limit moves from about 130k to 160k users (34k to 41k req/s).
